_meta: Per-capture GT. Keys are dateKey (YYYYMMDD) → capture-index (0=qmg_*.png, 1=qmg_*_2.png, 2=qmg_*_3.png). THE CAPTURE INDEX IS RUN-RELATIVE: the file qmg_<date>_<n>.png holds a DIFFERENT image in every run directory, so a capture index means nothing on its own — it means nothing without the run directory it was read in. Where a date has been corrected, its _notes entry names the run the entry is anchored to. The positions panel prints its own row count in its footer ('N Items in Personal WatchList', or 'K of N' when scrolled), and that count is the cheapest audit of a hand-made ground truth: a capture listing more tickers than the panel counts is wrong, and one listing fewer is missing a holding. crop: [x1,y1,x2,y2] in source-frame pixels.  The 94 captures that have pinned pixels live in test/fixtures/qmg_ground_truth/ -- a crop of the panel showing the ticker column AND the footer count, md5-pinned in manifest.json -- and tools/checkGroundTruthConsistency.js checks this file against that manifest. Each manifest case also records WHICH panel it was read from ('panel'), because the 2022-era frame carries three right-hand widgets and the upper watchlist prints the same footer form as the positions table. This file must not carry a duplicate top-level key: JSON.parse keeps the last one silently, and this file shipped with 24 dates each appearing twice. Note: 20230518+ videos use wider table layout — default crop (0.86,0.14) may cut off left edge; use 0.83,0.17 for newer videos. 20231201 and 20231215 are NOT Revere earnings frames, as an earlier note here claimed: every capture of both dates shows Qullamaggie's TC2000 'A - Positions' panel (verified against the pixels 2026-11-04, see their _notes). 20230519 has not been checked.
